card.name: Just before censorship words
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, be, was, under, through, is) and the start of a word, right where the next word is likely 'censor', 'censorship' or 'controls'. The setting is text on censoring, banning or restricting speech and media.

modes.label: Word start of censor
modes.description: The first letter of 'censored' split off, with the rest of the word coming next.
modes.example: Should it be<< c>>ensored in any way?

modes.label: Linking word before restriction
modes.description: A preposition or auxiliary verb right before a word about censoring, blocking or controlling speech.
modes.example: government's attempts<< to>> shut it down proved futile.

modes.label: Internet control discussion
modes.description: Words in talk about Chinese internet control or regulation.
modes.example: Chinese users chafe under<< internet>> controls and management.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words starting with 'c', such as 'censor', and away from unrelated word starts.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a word like 'censored' or 'censorship' is about to come in text on speech restrictions.
